title: backup.part (platform → server, reliable)
description: A round backup too large to go inline, sent in parts before the failover match.assign that names it by resume.backup_ref (FLEET.md §11.3). Only to a server with the match.backup_parts.v1 capability. The server keeps the parts in memory by sha256 (at most 4 files, 16 MiB, two minutes after the last part) and assembles them when the assign asks for that file.
